name: dynamics-connection-compatibility
title: Build the official-NuGet Dynamics 365 access gateway
description: Build a shared Dynamics 365 8.2/9.1 connection-management architecture with permanent Embedded, Dedicated Gateway, and Central Gateway deployment modes; deployment-owned Data8 or separately pinned Microsoft-worker connectors; deterministic resource cleanup; and zero session/resource leakage.
creator: codex
notes: 2026-08-04 user-approved connection-management direction supersedes earlier Data8-removal language. Direct Web API and D365APP01 CRMWeb/IFD diagnostics are not routes or gates. Data8 is a permanent ConnectorKind alongside separately pinned net48 official workers; ConnectionMode is Embedded, DedicatedGateway, or CentralGateway. P1 contract/profile boundary and P2 deterministic Data8 disposal are implemented locally. Package01FeeReadsEnabled remains false until its matching gateway operation and live lifecycle gates pass.
nextAction: Implement P3: generation-owned per-Organization Data8 connector pools and an IConnectorRouter driven only by a resolved deployment profile. Then implement the shared Embedded/Dedicated/Central execution path. Keep all products free of connector/credential state, preserve Data8 and worker choices in deployment-owned JSON, and prove isolation, drain, cancellation, capacity, and no-leak gates before enabling product traffic.
